==Uses==
After you have reached 40{{Happiness}} with Ms. Charm and completed the two tasks related to the [[Trade Office]] (see [[Merchant|the Merchant's quest]] for more details), you could ask her to promote your veggie business by crafting a piece of {{PAGENAME}} and giving it to her. You will gain {{Item|Fame|1}} for the [[Trade Office]], 10{{Happiness}} for the [[Merchant]] and be able to buy {{PAGENAME}} for 1{{Gold Coin}} from [[Ms. Charm]] and sell it for 75{{Silver Coin}} to her.

==Notes==
[[Marquis Teodoro Jr.]] gives you 1x jewelry after completing his quest to have 7 refugees.

[[Donkey]] gives you a piece of jewelry after sending him the cookbook and waiting a day.
